opportunity.title: Survey-Based Research Platform and Platform Management Tool (RFI)
opportunity.description: The VA Acquisition Academy needs a Software as a Service survey-based research platform and platform management tool to securely collect responses to a competency survey it is piloting for acquisition human capital planning. Required: software subscriptions, maintenance and support. Period of performance is a 12-month base plus four 12-month options. Respondents provide a rough order of magnitude price against the salient characteristics by email by Oct 20, 2026.

sources.snippet:
The VA Acquisition Academy (VAAA) was created to address the growing acquisition workforce challenge facing the Department of Veterans Affairs and the Federal Government overall. With the downsizing from the last decade and the loss of institutional knowledge resulting from baby-boomer retirements, the acquisition workforce has been strained to keep pace with the increased amount of and complexities associated with outsourced work in support of the VA mission.

rationale.point: The RFI seeks a SaaS survey platform for acquisition human capital planning (Claim #1), but the prior similar effort was a small $569k Qualtrics contract (Claim #2), suggesting limited scope that may not align with Atlas Federal's typical $5M–$60M prime contract range.

The prior incumbent held a Qualtrics-specific contract (Claim #2), indicating potential product lock-in that Atlas Federal may not match without an existing Qualtrics partnership or comparable survey-platform capability.

risks: Follow-on solicitation may be set aside for small business, excluding Atlas Federal as prime.
Contract value likely too small to justify prime pursuit for a large business.
Lack of demonstrated Qualtrics or survey-platform past performance.
nextSteps: Verify whether Atlas Federal has a Qualtrics partnership or equivalent survey-platform capability.
Assess if RFI response could position the firm for larger VA acquisition human capital work beyond the initial tool.
Consider teaming with a small business that holds a Qualtrics relationship for any follow-on.

classification.summary: The VA Acquisition Academy needs a SaaS survey-based research platform and management tool with subscriptions, maintenance, and support for a 12‑month base period plus four optional years to securely collect competency survey responses for acquisition human capital planning.
